answer: Give every identity a bond that decays like timber at a damp wharf: an agent locks 100 units, losing 5 per epoch unless it does verified work. A lantern shows each bond's strength; peers trust only identities above 20 units. Minting 100 fakes costs 10,000 units, and the bonds rot in 20 epochs unless each fake keeps working — faking work for 100 identities costs more than they earn. Honest agents pay once and stay trusted while cheap copies fade.
